showcase.title: Turn on your PC. SRA handles the rest.
showcase.desc: SRA interacts with the PC client of Honkai: Star Rail through image recognition — no emulator and no game files touched. From launching the game and farming Trailblaze Power to claiming rewards, Currency Wars and the Divergent Universe, one config covers your daily routine.

noEmulator.title: No emulator
noEmulator.text: Drives the native PC client with stable recognition and low overhead.

servers.title: Every server
servers.text: Official, Bilibili and global clients, with automatic game path detection.

hosting.title: Run it anywhere
hosting.text: Desktop, CLI, WebUI and MCP all share the same backend.

features.title: Hand the daily grind to SRA
features.desc: Every task can be toggled on its own, or combined into a single daily pipeline.

launch.title: Launch Game
launch.text: Detects the game path and starts the client on official, Bilibili and global servers, with region selection for global.

power.title: Trailblaze Power
power.text: Mix stages, counts and battle order freely; prioritise double-drop events and auto-calculate from development goals.

rewards.title: Claim Rewards
rewards.text: Support rewards, redemption codes, assignments, mail, daily training and Gift of Odyssey — fresh codes are fetched automatically.

currencyWars.title: Currency Wars
currencyWars.text: Standard or overclocked games, with rerolling for Boss affixes, investment strategies and environments. Custom strategies supported.

universe.title: Divergent Universe
universe.text: Supports both periodic calculation and full runs, stopping automatically once the weekly point cap is reached.

accounts.title: Multi-account
accounts.text: Store configuration per account and switch automatically — manage several accounts with ease.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.text: Write plugins in Python, drop them into the extension folder, and get a generated settings UI.

api.title: MCP & REST API
api.text: A built-in MCP server and HTTP API make it easy to plug into AI agents or your own dashboard.

shots.title: See exactly what it does
shots.tasks: Task config: pick the tasks and tune their options
shots.power: Trailblaze Power: choose stages, counts and order
shots.rewards: Claim Rewards: collect everything in one pass

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.text: Download, extract and go. Configure and start everything from a GUI.

cli.title: Command line
cli.text: Script the common operations or schedule them, with startup arguments and scripts.

server.title: Server
server.text: Open the WebUI in a browser to control SRA remotely, and use the REST API or MCP.

steps.title: Three steps to your first run

one.title: Download and extract
one.text: Pick the package that fits you and extract it anywhere.

two.title: Finish the setup
two.text: The game path is detected on first launch; confirm resolution and account.

three.title: Select tasks and start
three.text: Tick the tasks you need, save the config and hit start.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text: Everything from downloading to each task in detail.

api.title: Public API
api.text: Query announcements, redemption codes and more.

mcp.title: MCP tools
mcp.text: Let AI clients operate SRA and the game directly.

strategy.title: Strategy site
strategy.text: Share and discover custom Currency Wars strategies.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.text: What every release added and fixed.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.text: Download the latest release and finish your first run in minutes.

meta.title: Download
meta.description: Download StarRailAssistant packages, or get it through MirrorChyan, GitHub, PyPI and Docker.

hero.title: Get StarRailAssistant
hero.desc: Pick the package that fits you and unzip it — every edition is free and open source.
hero.note: Use MirrorChyan if GitHub is slow; the Release page always has the current version number.

packages.title: Choose a package
packages.desc: Each release ships in several flavours; the difference is which components and runtime are bundled.

full.desc: The GUI SRA.exe, the CLI SRA-cli.exe, the server SRA-server.exe and all core resources — the complete feature set.

core.desc: Only SRA-cli.exe and core resources. Suited to command-line or headless setups; bring your own config files.

lite.desc: Desktop build plus the Python sources; requires a Python 3.12 environment you set up yourself.

resources.desc: Only tasks, extensions, resources and the manifest, used to update resources inside a Core package.

channels.title: Other ways to get it
channels.desc: Besides the official releases, you can install or update SRA through the channels below.

mirror.title: MirrorChyan
mirror.desc: Third-party accelerated distribution that also powers automatic updates; only the acceleration is paid, SRA itself is free.

github.title: GitHub Releases
github.desc: The official channel, with every package and all previous versions.

quark.title: Quark Drive
quark.desc: A mainland mirror that may lag behind; prefer the options above when possible.

pypi.title: Install from PyPI
pypi.desc: Works on Windows, Linux and macOS with Python 3.12. Run sra init afterwards to fetch the WebUI and core resources.

docker.title: Deploy with Docker
docker.desc: The image only contains SRA-server (WebUI, HTTP API and MCP); inside a container only cloud gaming is available.

docs.title: Full download and installation guide
docs.desc: Package contents, PyPI installs, Docker deployment and update instructions all live in the docs.
